question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"plot."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Plot" **refers to the series of events which form the story of a novel, film, etc. (नाटक या उपन्‍यास का कथानक, कथावस्‍तु)

 
 
• Example: *The **plot**__ of the movie was very complex and hard to follow.*
 
 
 
• It can also refer to the storyline or sequence of events in a book or movie.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• **Correct passage**:

“Why?" said Harry in surprise, “There is a __**plot**__, Harry Potter. A plot to make most terrible things ______ (2) ______ at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry ______ (3) ______," whispered Dobby, suddenly trembling all over. “Dobby has ______ (4) ______ months, sir. Harry Potter ______ (5) ______ in peril. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Paper"** refers to thin sheets of material used for writing or printing. (काग़ज़)
 
• **"Notebook"** refers to a book with blank pages used for taking notes or writing. (कापी, नोटबुक)
 
• **"Diary"** refers to a book used for recording daily events or thoughts. (डायरी, दैनिकी, रोज़नामचा)
